summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd, a Japanese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Eighth Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held July 24, 2026. Shareholders approved the financial statements for fiscal year ended April 30, 2026. Votes in favor were 8,325,667, against 43,980, with approximately 24.71% of exercisable votes present. This is a routine meeting results disclosure, not a special situation, so no deal terms or structural analysis apply.
